quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked line. Stop before a crosswalk if there is no line. Stop before the intersection if there is no crosswalk. Only go when you can see it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane from the right. Be ready to make space for them.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let other traffic cross before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic cross before you go.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let cars and pedestrians cross in front of you. Stop if needed before going.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are driving the wrong way on a one-way street.
You can go if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are driving the wrong way on a one-way street.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign ahead, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around if you are driving toward it.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to safely join your traffic flow.
Traffic is merging from another road. Stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to safely join your traffic flow.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge ahead. Check your side and rear mirrors. Move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers clear space.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You cannot pass other cars here.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot pass other cars here.
questions.explanation: A yellow triangular sign with black lettering means no passing zone. It appears on the left side of two-lane roads where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must drive through the intersection at this speed.
The highest safe speed is 55 mph.
You cannot drive slower than this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest safe speed is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the maximum speed limit. You can drive slower based on road conditions, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: An orange-colored sign like this means:
questions.explanation: Orange signs mean construction is happening. Drive with caution.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all cars that came before or after you go first.
Look in all directions before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look in all directions before going.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a full stop and look in all directions before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign warns you that you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and obey the posted speed limit.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns of road work ahead. Stay alert and watch for temporary traffic control devices when driving through the work area.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep or long downgrade ahead. The hill may have sharp curves.

questions.question: This sign indicates:

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This low clearance sign shows how much space is available between the road and a bridge or overpass (for example, 12 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: This bicyclist is signaling:
questions.explanation: Bicycles don't have turn signals, so bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead. A straight left arm means the bicyclist is turning left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a winding road ahead.

questions.question: This yellow warning sign means:

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to tell drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: This sign is used to warn drivers about:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions right ahead. This sign warns of a curve to the right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Orange, diamond-shaped signs mark construction, maintenance, and work areas. They help guide drivers and pedestrians safely through these zones. Fines for traffic violations may be higher in these marked areas.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions right ahead. This sign warns you to slow down for a sharp turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that move slowly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign warns that fewer lanes are coming and traffic must merge left.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is allowed only on a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a bright yellow-green background. These signs warn you about upcoming conditions, including curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells you what you must do. Where this sign is posted, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to situations ahead. This sign tells you the right lane is ending and prepares you for traffic that may need to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downgrade is ahead. Check your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They tell you about dangers ahead. This sign warns you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Drive 35 mph or slower around the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive 35 mph or slower around the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They tell you about dangers ahead. A speed plaque under the sign shows the safe speed for the curve ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go until it is safe and the way is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon become one lane. Be ready to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign shows a crosswalk ahead. Watch for people crossing and let them cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. It is illegal to turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests and use flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mean work zone activity. Watch for orange signs, cones, or barrels. Be ready for unexpected conditions. This sign warns you a flagger is coming. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn about hazards ahead. Orange signs mean construction work. Stay alert for unexpected conditions.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that traffic may merge into your lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells drivers the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate the curves.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and yield to pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down and be prepared to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and yield to pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Come to a complete stop at the marked line or before the crosswalk. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign alerts drivers that a side road will join ahead. Be ready for traffic entering from the side.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always mean?
questions.explanation: Farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back to show they move slowly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns drivers to be careful in wet conditions because the road will be slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: This sign shows a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing without signals, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disability placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You cannot turn when the light is red.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn when the light is red.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that they cannot turn right or left when the traffic light is red.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.
A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must choose to go right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must choose to go right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that the road splits ahead. You must bear either right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to watch for people walking across the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when it is wet. Drive carefully on slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right on a red light with caution.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. What is it warning you about?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
Traffic is moving both ways on this road.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is moving both ways on this road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that traffic is moving in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to stop if the light is flashing.

questions.explanation: A yellow sign with a traffic signal picture warns that a traffic signal is coming. Get ready to respond to it.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Keep your regular speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the railroad tracks. Wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before going.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns about an upcoming winding road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A bicycle repair shop is ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to areas where animals, people, and vehicles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign tells you to follow important rules. This sign means drivers should keep the left lane open for passing and faster traffic.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?
questions.explanation: A diamond-shaped yellow sign warns of possible danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of possible dangers in or near work areas.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A side road is entering from the left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Start slowing down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at intersections where oncoming traffic is common.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and let traffic on the main road pass before you merge.
Always come to a complete stop.
Turn on your signal and drive into traffic at normal speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let traffic on the main road pass before you merge.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must wait for traffic on the other road to pass. You don't need to stop if no traffic is coming, but always slow down and enter carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?

options.text: It turns sharply right, then left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve right, then curve left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers a steep hill is coming. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: When this sign is on the back of a vehicle, it means:

options.text: An animal is pulling the vehicle.
The vehicle travels at 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle travels at 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: You may see this sign on slow vehicles like bicycles, horse carts, or farm equipment. It warns other drivers that the vehicle will travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they are leaving a divided highway and entering a road with traffic moving both ways.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers of a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this white sign tell you to do?

options.text: Turn left only when you see a green arrow.
Turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Wait for the solid green light before turning left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A sign that says "yield" means slow down and be ready to stop for any traffic, cyclist, or pedestrian. Once it is safe, you may proceed.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve or get narrower ahead. You may see this sign on sharp curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: Blue traffic signs offer information on:

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs tell you about nearby services for drivers. These signs show where to find rest areas, food, gas stations, or hospitals.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you an intersection is coming up so you can prepare to stop or turn.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs give commands you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that you are leaving a one-way highway and entering a two-way highway ahead.

questions.question: If you approach a flashing red traffic light, you:

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, then yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs tell you what is prohibited. This sign means you are traveling the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: This symbol is used for:
questions.explanation: An orange reflective triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you that you may lose control of your car. Slow down when you see wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mean you are near a school zone or school crossing. When you see this sign, stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; the road curves ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: If you want to turn left at an intersection with this signal, what should you do?

options.text: Turn if you yield to other drivers.
Stop completely and proceed when it is safe.
Stop completely and stay stopped while the red arrow is showing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and stay stopped while the red arrow is showing.
questions.explanation: When a red left arrow appears, you must stop before the intersection or crosswalk. Stay stopped as long as the red arrow is visible.

questions.question: What kind of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangular sign is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see a yield sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Stop as quickly as you can.
Stop and go only when the intersection is clear.

questions.explanation: At a flashing yellow light, slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Give the right-of-way to other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to other drivers.
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that turning in the direction of the arrow (right) is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending ahead.
Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign directs traffic to the right of a barrier or island. The road ahead is divided.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must do. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending. Get ready to change lanes.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends and meets another road ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and look for traffic from both directions before going.
Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
Keep your speed steady and check for traffic from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
questions.explanation: The yield sign has three sides. It tells you to slow down and stop if needed to let vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and places where you are not allowed to drive. You may see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp in the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. Round signs are only used to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. Making a left turn at an intersection with this sign is unsafe and against the law.
